description: The USB ids Atlas matches, one table. Each boot_modes entry is a download mode (a boot ROM or loader that takes a board in USB boot): Atlas gives the user access to it on Linux (udev) and binds WinUSB to it on Windows (the installer). devices/tools/gen-usb-ids.py writes those files from this table and from devices/ecosystem.json; crates/atlas-usb-ids/src/lib.rs is the Rust table, and a test in atlas-devices checks it against this file. Board facts (chip, medium, load address) stay in the board's record and family file.
